**Accountability**
**Key elements:**
strategizes, prioritizes, impacts projects, makes decisions

Your ability to plan and implement strategy and prioritize and own different scopes and complexities of work.

You honor commitments to the team and consistently deliver on projects.
• You follow specific direction from your people and project managers.
• You adhere to the prioritization offered by your people and project managers.
• You contribute to projects and support on multiple workstreams.
• You make effective decisions related to your projects and request support if ever uncertain.

**Influence**
**Key elements:**
builds relationships, establishes trust, partners across boundaries, resolves conflict

Your ability to understand and leverage the social and political dynamics within the organization and build partnerships across organizational boundaries to achieve business objectives.

You understand PCG’s culture and EPIC values (Entrepreneurial spirt, Passion, Impact, Community) and demonstrate them through your behaviors.
•You have good relationships with your project team members.
•You are sought by your peers for support.

**Culture**
**Key elements:**
attracts talent, builds DEI, demonstrates corporate citizenship, lives values

Your ability to build a culture where talent want to work, diversity, equity, and inclusion are engrained, corporate citizenship thrives, and company values drive behavior.

You understand PCG’s culture and EPIC values (Entrepreneurial spirt, Passion, Impact, Community) and demonstrate them through your behaviors.
•You acknowledge and celebrate your colleague's unique experiences and perspectives.
•You understand the value of a diverse, equitable, and inclusive people culture.
•You participate in Employee Resource Groups, committees, community service, or find your own ways to positively contribute to PCG’s culture.
ABA Buisness Management

**Business Acumen**
**Key elements:**
assesses competitors, researches markets, aligns products & services, assesses opportunities 

Your understanding of the market, customers, competitors, trends, business models, etc. and ability to transfer your knowledge into opportunity.

You have a general understanding of our products, services, and approach to market.

You have a basic understanding of our products, services, and approach to market.
•You identify our competitors in the marketplace.
•You proactively research relevant industry trends and bring topics to the team for discussion on market opportunities.
•You effectively review RFPs and provide feedback.

**Business Development**
**Key elements:**
processes proposals, writes proposals, leverages relationships, wins bids

Your ability to process, write, and manage proposals and convert relationships and opportunities into paying clients.

You understand the proposal process including opportunity management, proposal management, and compliance management.
•You add valuable support to the proposal manager throughout the process.
•You understand the necessary legal and compliance review processes and compile forms required for proposals.
•You prepare general proposal sections, including corporate background and experience.

**Business Planning, Analysis, & Results**
**Key elements:**
budgets, prices, monitors, reports 

Your ability to budget, monitor, forecast and model the financial parameters of projects and portfolios; And your ability to deliver business results in line with revenue, cost, margin, value prop, and positioning expectations.

You are aware of project budgets and diligently track your time and expenses to meet project expectations.
•You are aware of bill rates and how they are used to determine project budgets, costs, and margins.
•You are aware of utilization rates and discuss with your supervisor a plan to ensure targets are met.
•You are aware of core company financial metrics and how project success is measured.
ABA Client Mangement

**Client Relationships**
**Key elements:**
acts professionally, earns trust, establishes references, wins rebids & add-on work 

Your ability to build and maintain relationships across customer organizations that ensures successful partnership between the customer and our company and extend business opportunities.

You provide professional client support and service when called upon.
•You know our clients and understand the services we provide them.
•You respond to inquiries and requests in a quick and timely manner.

**Client Problem Solving**
**Key elements:**
listens, analyzes, proposes solutions, solves problems

Your ability to make observations, apply research and data, test hypotheses, draw conclusions, and employ client-oriented approaches to achieve desired outcomes.

You actively and effectively listen to clients and help to identify unmet needs.
•You document key takeaways and action items from client meetings.
•You use research and data to process information and inform hypotheses.
•You surface and articulate basic problems and explore solutions within existing work projects.

**Client Project Management & Results**
**Key elements:**
manages projects, delivers results, meets client expectations

Your ability to establish project scope and objectives, oversee the completion of the defined work, track, review, and regulate the progress of a project, and deliver results that satisfy or exceed client expectations.

You seek opportunities to learn and practice project management standards.
•You understand the process groups of project management including initiating, planning, executing, controlling, and closing a project.

•You understand the fundamental knowledge areas that effective project managers need to grasp including integration, scope, schedule/time, cost, quality, procurement, labor, communications, risk, and stakeholder management.
•You understand project goals and deliverables, as well as your role within the project.
•You complete assigned deliverables in accordance with quality and time expectations.

Your ability to gain subject matter expertise that establishes your brand as a trusted partner and advisor in your role, practice, and company.

You have relevant experience, skills, or education to help you learn your role.
•You embrace learning by asking for input and ideas from others.
•You understand how your role aligns with the goals of your team.

**Tools & Technology**
**Key elements:**

Your ability to use the required tools, technologies, products, and systems necessary to provide data and value to clients and company.

You can use the required tools, technologies, products, and systems necessary for your role.
•You can learn a variety of different tools and technologies.
•You invest time in learning and mastering tools that enhance your skillset and effectiveness.

You write, speak, and manage topics clearly as it relates to your work.
•You actively listen as team members present complex problems, goals, and ideas, and occasionally contribute in a way that is accessible.
•You practice professional verbal and written communication skills, in both one-on-one and group settings.

You work well with others and are receptive to feedback.
•You understand the current way of working is just one of many possible approaches, and that each approach has its own advantages and limitations.
•You understand that “it’s always been done this way” is not an acceptable defense for performance or quality.
•You understand incremental development approaches, where each stage of a project builds on the one before.
